Treasure Chest Sounds

All treasures sorted!

Every card went to the chest that matches its sound.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

This game trains sound sorting with real recorded audio and generous feedback. A miss is met with a hint and a replay button, never a penalty — the habit being built is listening again, not being right first time. The sounds are played as pure sounds (sss, not “suh”), which is exactly how reading research says to teach them.

Prefer paper? The Treasure Chest Sounds worksheet brings the same activity to the kitchen table with a parent-read sound script and an answer line — printing a worksheet never marks a class complete.
